about_the_game:
DRIVE. SHOOT. SURVIVE.

Navigate through an open-world zombie-infested wasteland in customizable vehicles equipped with weapons and defensive systems. Battle massive hordes of 4,000~ undead while completing objectives, rescuing survivors, and scrounging for resources in this high-octane zombie survival game.

VEHICULAR CHAOS

Master precise driving controls with realistic physics. Drift around corners, perform tactical braking maneuvers, and unleash nitro boosts to escape overwhelming situations.

MASSIVE ZOMBIE HORDES

Face thousands of zombies that move, attack, and swarm with terrifyingly realistic behavior. Watch as they dynamically react to your vehicle, creating emergent gameplay scenarios that never play out the same way twice.

GUNNER SYSTEM

Equip your ride with a variety of weapons and recruit AI gunners to man them. Position shooters strategically around your vehicle to create overlapping fields of fire as you blast through the undead masses.

VISCERAL COMBAT

Experience satisfying, impactful combat with a sophisticated damage system. Target zombie weak points for critical damage, send bodies flying with vehicle impacts, and watch as your bullets punch through multiple enemies at once.

VEHICLE CUSTOMIZATION

Reinforce your ride with armored plating, upgrade your engine for better performance, and install devastating weapons to create the ultimate zombie-killing machine.

SPRAWLING APOCALYPSE

Navigate through a massive open world filled with looting opportunities, deadly zombie nests, and the occasional desperate survivor in need of rescue.

The road to salvation is paved with the undead. How long will you survive?

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: intel i5-4590 or similar
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 or similar
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
